title: Law to speed up payments on human services contracts
summary: This bill would require City agencies to complete budget and system approvals needed for invoicing human services contracts by the contract start date or registration date. If an agency misses that deadline, it would have to notify the contractor and the city chief procurement officer of what remains outstanding and when it will be resolved. The city chief procurement officer would also have to report quarterly to the Mayor and Council Speaker on contracts that missed the deadline.
